description:
Full detail of one awarded contract by its GlobalGov award id (from search_awards) or its award number / PIID: vendor (name, UEI, CAGE), dates, value, ceiling and obligation, period of performance, contract and award type, competition (extent competed, procedures, set-aside, number of offers), modifications, place of performance, agency, office and the linked solicitation id. An award number can match up to 5 records.
FREE tier: 20 calls (shared with search_awards) per visitor per 24h. A GlobalGov plan with API access lifts the cap.

award.description: Award id (UUID) or award number / PIID.
